goal: Freeze a deterministic CPU-synthetic single-discrete-GPU timed-service and contention model.
scope: compute, memory, H2D and D2H primary service lanes
shared-fabric contention for memory and copies
exact integer duration and rational-clock completion snapping
dependency-aware ordered arrival, ready and completion queues
complete generated EventIR key and fixed priority registry
hash-bound complete checkpoint and reachable-prefix restore
non_goals: residency, prefetch, eviction or routing policy
multi-GPU, NVLink, P2P or coherent UMA

dependencies.phase3_core: frozen numeric, rational-clock and SHA-256 primitives only

assumptions: Operations have passed the frozen canonical IR boundary before entering the low-level Phase 4 model.
CPU-synthetic service profiles are functional or first-order analytic and remain RANGE_UNKNOWN.
One Phase 4 state machine is the sole scheduling authority.
unknowns: measured service curves and launch overhead
production trace scale and queue pressure
alternative_designs: A second Phase 3 scheduler was rejected because it would create split scheduling authority.
Floating-point service time was rejected because it would violate exact event time.
Caller-labelled authority hashes were rejected in favor of exact artifact hashes.
risks: The 1000-operation fixture is an operational envelope, not production-scale validation.
Service timing is synthetic and cannot support GPU performance or break-even claims.
The portable checkpoint restores by deterministic prefix replay; production-scale optimization remains future work.
validation_method: native Phase 4 and inherited Phase 3 ASAN/UBSAN execution
contention, dependency, rational-edge and priority tests
checkpoint boundary, corruption, tamper and unreachable-state negative tests
acceptance_criteria: three roles GO on one candidate ledger with empty blockers
owner_decisions: Phase 3 GO authorizes Phase 4 CPU-synthetic implementation.
Push is permitted after each completed phase.
next_legal_action: After same-hash GO, freeze Phase 4 and begin Phase 5 routing, residency and policy implementation using CPU synthetic fixtures only.
forbidden_actions: modification or reinterpretation of frozen G3 or S4 evidence
